parts.hook: Crossing over into a world of steam, machinery, divination and hidden gods, Zhou Mingrui wakes as Klein Moretti — with a revolver on the desk and a mysterious crimson moon outside. So begins the Fool's ascent.

The Tarot Club is growing, and Klein's life as a Nighthawk turns serious: séances, hidden sects, and a first real battle that leaves scars. Meanwhile, above the gray fog, the Fool quietly collects believers.

Mr. Fool's name is spreading. Spirit channeling, Backlund's secret gathering, a three-way deal, and sealed artifacts that should never be studied — Klein walks the line between Seer and something far greater.
Everything built since the crimson moon comes due: a new potion, an inverted mausoleum that should not be opened, and the funeral that closes Volume 1.

Klein leaves Tingen behind and starts over in Backlund as the detective Sherlock Moriarty — a rented flat on Minsk Street, a shingle nobody trusts yet, and a sacrificial trial he has to survive alone. Above the gray fog, the Fool's Tarot Club keeps growing.

A five-person gathering, Cards of Blasphemy, and a commission from The World. On the ground, Sherlock Moriarty takes real cases — the Psychology Alchemists, a golden rose, and a bell tower at midnight that answers back.

The Adorer, a Sun Brooch, and an authority no Seer should be holding. Klein's cases pull him deeper into Backlund's cults and its aristocracy — while a psychiatrist, a tracker and a banquet all circle the same secret.

Capim's dinner, and the show begins. Black armour, a black crown, and a curtain call that leaves the newspapers grasping for a name: the Hero Bandit Dark Emperor. By the end, a duke is dead and someone has to be the scapegoat.

The Great Haze descends on Backlund and the dying start in the thousands. A prince's fall, an Aurora Order ritual, and a volume that closes on a train pulling into the Land of Hope. It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.
